analysis_plan.primary_family: Holm FWER over 8 tests (4 RTT tiers x {mean, median}) on cold TTFT
analysis_plan.secondary_family: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR over 8 tests (4 RTT tiers x {mean, median}) on warm TTFT
deviations: Design §2 lists the H3 primary family as '4 one-sided permutation tests, Holm-adjusted', while §7's pre-registered battery prescribes the delta CI + permutation test on BOTH mean and median, and the dispatch runs the identical battery on both statistics. Holm is applied over the 8-test family (primary adjusted_p); the 4-test reading (mean only) is reported alongside as adjusted_p_4test_reading on each cold-mean cell. In this data both readings give identical verdicts: all 4 cold-mean cells have p = 1/10001, Holm(8) = 0.0008, Holm(4) = 0.0004, all < 0.05.

Warm strata contribute 2 records per query (repeats 1-2), so the warm battery runs at n = 240/arm (new) and n = 100/arm (old); the frozen design N = 120/arm refers to distinct measured queries. The pre-registered §7 battery (repeats 1+) is run as-is.

Old campaign: 3 SPHP records (rtt 0: query 280a3955 repeat 0, eba80711 repeat 1, f775d1e4 repeat 2) have sphp_hit=null and are excluded from the hit-rate denominators (n=147/150 at rtt 0; the NEW campaign has zero nulls, n=1440). Their valid TTFT values remain in the latency battery.
